data: Which of the following remain at the same accuracy when alpha increases?

The question asks which of the three models remain at the same accuracy when alpha increases. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the accuracy of three models: Radical-enhanced model, C&W, and word2vec, with K=10. The x-axis represents alpha, and the y-axis represents accuracy.

Looking at the graph:

1. The Radical-enhanced model line shows a decreasing trend as alpha increases.
2. The C&W model line remains relatively flat, indicating little change in accuracy as alpha increases.
3. The word2vec model line also remains relatively flat, showing little change in accuracy as alpha increases.

Therefore, the C&W and word2vec models remain at the same accuracy when alpha increases.
